resources.string: The account and history remain available for viewing. It is excluded from new entries and active totals. Related recurring entries and transfers are paused. Unarchive from account configuration; series will not resume automatically.

Counterparts become external entries included in income and expenses. The account, opening balance, configuration and all its entries will be erased. Counterparts in other accounts remain, unlinked: their balances and clearing do not change. Related series are stopped; surviving historical states are preserved. This is permanent. Existing backups remain available.
%1$d entry/entries erased; %2$d counterpart(s) kept; %3$d series affected.
The vault must retain at least one account. Archive the last account or create another one before deleting it.
Swipe left to archive, right to delete. Confirmation is always required.
